facts.fact: Brawley 判断 Clay 把动感情等同于软弱，这是他的根本缺陷
facts.anchor: has convinced himself that if he lets his guard down and catches feelings, it will make him weak

facts.fact: Brawley 以自己的关系反驳：爱 Vero 只会让他更强
facts.anchor: Loving him doesn’t make me weak. If anything, it makes me stronger

facts.fact: Brawley 不随众人追，直接去油罐车等他——他算准 Kayla 会奔向 Vero 这个安全区
facts.anchor: She will go where she thinks Vero will go, as he is her safe space amongst us

facts.fact: Kayla 在油罐车里用枪指着 Brawley，拒绝放下武器，要他给出理由
facts.anchor: “Give me a good reason why I should.”

facts.fact: Brawley 说明他来的目的不是射击而是借 Kayla 报复 Vero，并直接评估她是否构成威胁
facts.anchor: I eliminate threats. Are you a threat to me, Double P?

facts.fact: Kayla 表态：她羡慕两人的关系但不会以伤害 Brawley 为代价，威胁评估就此解除
facts.anchor: I want what you two have, but not at your expense

facts.fact: 三人亲密过程中两次停下确认（Are you okay / Give me a second），由 Kayla 的动作重新发令
facts.anchor: We do as she asks, then Vero presses his lips to her shoulder. When she rolls her hips forward, we know she’s ready

facts.fact: Ares 坚持带 Kayla 去处理油弹破皮伤口，两人之间有过一次 Brawley 看不懂的交流
facts.anchor: I see something pass between them
